theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R c : ℝ) (φ : Euclid n → ℝ) (u : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < R → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ k, IntegrableOn (u k) (ball 0 (2 * R))) → TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k x => ∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)) (fun _ => c) atTop (closedBall 0 R) → Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∫ x in ball 0 R, |u k x - ∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)| ≤ a k) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in ball 0 R, |u k x - c|) atTop (𝓝 0)
